name: Ruan Rueme
source: [spoiler]The Queen of the Celestial Realm.  She is also Note's and Amia's mother. [/spoiler]  She is the caretaker of the women's dorm at Trinity and generally displays a strong love of housekeeping.  A veteran of the great war, she was known for being the single strongest individual when on the defense in all the four worlds.  Her personality is cheery and motherly.
